description: The @-list that rises over the composer while an @ is typed at a word's start: the chats and the names of the chat's folder (files, code, commits, pull requests, routes, Kubernetes objects …) the Signal glossary knows.
opens: type @ at a word's start (start of line, or after a space or an opening bracket or quote)

parts.name: list
parts.shows: A popover above the box like the slash list, its left edge on the @. Each row: the kind's icon, the name (a chat's title; a Bot's name, never its chat's title), and a dim line "<what it is> · <summary>" with a time tip where it has a date. With nothing typed after the @, the chats come first. More rows arrive while the catalogue is still being read (the list shows it is waiting). A footer note says "{n} found" or "Nothing found".

decisions.said: @ references should work over the wire, prefer the host's own, and not block on slow hosts: results flow in with loading dots at the bottom left and the count at the bottom right.
decisions.rule: Every app's @ list lists names as they arrive, never waiting on a slow host, with working dots at its foot's left while more are coming and the count ('{n} found' / 'Nothing found') at its right.

decisions.said: The ⌘K / @ lists need a more sensible, time-aware default order (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: With nothing typed after the @, every app lists what was touched lately first, newest first (chats before other names); as you type, the match decides the order and recency only breaks ties

parts.name: search
parts.shows: What is typed after the @, spaces and all, is the search; the typed @search is coloured like a known @name. A new line, the caret moving back before the @, or words that name nothing end it.

actions.by: key Up / Down / Page Up / Page Down
key Tab, or Enter once an arrow has moved or while a single word is typed, or click a row
actions.does: Puts @name (or @{a name} for names with spaces) plus a space in place of the @search

actions.by: key Enter (several words typed, no arrow moved)

actions.does: Closes the list and sends / makes a new line
Closes the list; over "Nothing found" Esc does what it would have done (stop a turn)

parts.name: where it opens
parts.shows: Not inside code (a decorator's @, an address's @), and not while the slash list is up.

decisions.said: @ references should work in ordinary chats, not only in Meta, with the agent told briefly what each thing is.
decisions.rule: Every app's chat box has the same @ list as Meta's box: chats and the names of the chat's folder (files, commits, pull requests, Kubernetes objects…), put in as @name.
